title: Define deterministic historical audit report and remediation queue
objective: Define a canonical read-only audit report deterministically derived from a validated findings registry, including severity counts, report status and an owner-bound remediation queue, without executing real audits or remediation.
non_goals: populate real historical findings or reports
modify immutable historical evidence business code contracts or reports
integrate new checks into CI in this WU

forbidden_semantics: real historical findings or report population

required_invariants: report is READ_ONLY and deterministically derived from one validated findings registry
report binds findings registry manifest mapping plan batch and lot identities
CLEAN registry produces CLEAN report with empty remediation queue
any open BLOCKER finding produces BLOCKED report status
open non-blocker findings without an open blocker produce ACTION_REQUIRED status
non-empty registry with all findings CLOSED produces RESOLVED status
severity counts and open severity counts exactly equal the bound findings registry
remediation queue contains every and only OPEN finding
queue priority is deterministically mapped BLOCKER P0 MAJOR P1 MINOR P2 INFO P3
queue triage action is derived from the finding disposition and owner is copied exactly
queue order is priority then finding_id and queue ids are contiguous batch-lot-local identifiers
report identity is SHA-256 over canonical semantic material excluding only its identity field
all mutation permissions remain false and validator performs no repository mutation
acceptance_criteria: synthetic BLOCKED ACTION_REQUIRED and RESOLVED reports derive correctly
forged findings registry report binding counts status queue priority owner or identity fails closed
queue omission duplication reordering or extra entries fail closed
Lot45 or later report fails closed through bound findings validation
zero findings never creates a remediation queue
no real historical artifact report business state or runtime authority is mutated
separate adversarial test module and CI qualification are deferred to ENG-07.5-WU02

done_when: report schema policy and validator with deterministic self-check are defined
report and queue are fully derived from validated findings without mutation authority
severity ownership and triage rules are deterministic and fail closed
adversarial test module and CI integration are deferred to ENG-07.5-WU02
